tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Grandstream GRP2612 Basic HD IP Phone With Adapter is a professional-grade carrier-class VoIP phone designed for businesses, offices, call centers, and enterprise deployments. Featuring 4 SIP accounts, 4 line keys, HD audio technology, a 2.4-inch color LCD display, and advanced security features, the GRP2612 delivers reliable and crystal-clear communication for modern workplaces.


Built for mass deployment and easy management, the GRP2612 supports Grandstream's Device Management System (GDMS), allowing IT administrators to provision, manage, and monitor devices from a centralized cloud platform. With enterprise-level security, customizable faceplates, and support for up to 16 virtual BLF keys, it is an excellent choice for organizations seeking a dependable IP telephony solution.


Key Features


  • Supports 4 SIP accounts and 4 line keys
  • 2.4-inch color LCD display (320 × 240)
  • HD audio on handset and speakerphone
  • Up to 16 virtual BLF keys
  • 5-way audio conferencing
  • Dual Fast Ethernet ports
  • Noise Shield technology for reduced background noise
  • Enterprise-grade security protection
  • Secure boot, dual firmware images, and encrypted storage
  • GDMS cloud management support
  • Swappable faceplate for custom branding
  • Wall-mountable design
  • Power adapter included
